audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME across six fields: whys[0], whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] all call Olaf's W 'Vicious Strikes' and describe it as a lifesteal steroid. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s, 700 range. The lifesteal comes from his passive, Berserker Rage, scaling with missing Health. spikes[1].text also says 'Ragnarok strips CC immunity', which reads as the opposite of what it does.
audit.why: Riot's own text: W is 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield'; P is 'Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health'; R is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking'. The shield is exactly the missingInteractions item (shield-absorbs-burst) that never reached the page. Reckless Swing (E) is true damage on 11/10/9/8/7s at 325 range, so armour and MR are irrelevant to it. Undertow (Q) is 9s and refunds its cooldown when he retrieves the axe.
audit.corrected: Tough It Out (W) is a shield plus attack speed on 12-16s; Berserker Rage (P) is the missing-health lifesteal; Ragnarok grants disable immunity while he keeps attacking; Undertow's 9s cooldown resets on axe pickup, so standing on the axe denies the reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Olaf the 2+ items row, while whys[6], spikes[3].text and the late paragraph all say Ryze takes over at two items, and the packet chart says Ryze.
audit.why: The mirror already flipped its own 2+ items row to Ryze for exactly this reason. Here both layers say Olaf, so both need the matched flip.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] to Ryze, rating raised to match. Rows 0-5 stay as-is: Olaf owning levels 1-3 and first item is consistent with a 48.11% Ryze win rate and with the mirror.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 1-2 (Undertow), Lvl 6 (Ragnarok, 100/90/80s), 1st item (Seraph's into Rylai's), 2+ items. Olaf front-loads, Ryze arrives late — the ordering is right and only the wording inside spikes[0] and spikes[1] was wrong.
audit.corrected: Wording fixed; the spike timings are untouched.

edits.before: Olaf's Undertow axe slows you into a Vicious Strikes lifesteal trade at level 1 — you have only Q and no escape, so the math is entirely his.
edits.after: Olaf's Undertow axe slows you into a Berserker Rage lifesteal trade at level 1 — you have only Q and no escape, so the math is entirely his.

edits.before: His full kit trades (Undertow slow, Vicious Strikes sustain, Reckless Swing true damage) outpace your E-W-Q burst at equal levels before any items.
edits.after: His full kit trades (Undertow slow, Tough It Out shield, Reckless Swing true damage) outpace your E-W-Q burst at equal levels before any items.

edits.before: Olaf's Undertow axe slow into Vicious Strikes lifesteal makes him a kill threat the moment he lands the throw — stay behind minions to force the arc and deny the slow.
edits.after: Olaf's Undertow slow into a Tough It Out shield makes him a kill threat the moment he lands the throw — stay behind minions to force the arc and deny the slow.

edits.before: Ragnarok strips CC immunity: your W root does nothing to him in his R window, so his all-in becomes a pure HP and lifesteal trade you will likely lose.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking — root him before he presses it, because afterwards it is a stat trade you lose.

edits.before: Bait Undertow (axe) before walking up — his slow is the only reason he can stick and land Vicious Strikes lifesteal trades
edits.after: Bait Undertow before walking up — the slow is the only reason he sticks, and Tough It Out (12-16s) eats your burst

edits.before: Land Undertow (axe) to slow you, then close with Vicious Strikes active so lifesteal trades bleed you faster than you heal
edits.after: Land Undertow to slow you, then close with Tough It Out up so the shield and Berserker Rage lifesteal bleed you out

edits.before: Level 1 is Olaf's — he throws Undertow (axe) to slow you, activates Vicious Strikes for attack-speed and lifesteal, and turns any trade into a bleeding contest you cannot win with a single Q. Walk behind minions so his arc must curve through creeps; if the axe misses his cooldown is long and that is your only window to CS without punishment. At level 2 he gains the full slow-into-lifesteal loop and can dive you under tower if you overextend, so match level, back off when his axe is up, and only touch him in the half-second after the axe lands and he has to run forward to retrieve it — that retrieve walk is the one moment he is committed without his slow.
edits.after: Level 1 is Olaf's — he throws Undertow (axe) to slow you, activates Tough It Out for attack speed and a shield, and turns any trade into a bleeding contest you cannot win with a single Q. Walk behind minions so his arc must curve through creeps; if the axe misses it is 9s down and that is your only window to CS without punishment. At level 2 he gains the full slow-into-shield loop and can dive you under tower if you overextend, so match level, back off when his axe is up, and only touch him in the half-second after the axe lands and he has to run forward to retrieve it — that retrieve walk is the one moment he is committed without his slow.

edits.before: Olaf whiffs Undertow (Axe) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Undertow resets its 9s cooldown if he picks the axe up — stand on it.

edits.before: That is Olaf’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is true damage — resistances won't save you.

notes: Biggest find of this slice: 'Vicious Strikes' is Olaf's legacy W name and appeared in six fields, each time attributing lifesteal to the W instead of the passive. Corrected everywhere it appeared in a writable path. Per the mirror, whether Ragnarok cleanses an already-applied Rune Prison root or only blocks new disables is NOT in Riot's text — the rewritten spikes[1] deliberately says 'root him before he presses it' rather than asserting either behaviour.
